all.reason: Recalibrate self-translation timing for the ZIP-expanded JavaAPI corpus (471 to 512 compiled classes), from five paired rounds of commit 291427fe25 in run 38170288209 attempt 1 (EPYC 9V74, median 0.628) and attempt 2 (EPYC 7763, median 0.626). Control: pre-PR master run 38159828789 on EPYC 7763 measured 0.596; run 38112530874 on EPYC 9V74 measured 0.586. Local before/after native binaries generated from the same translator sources differ only in a JZlib version constant and constant-pool indexes; median native time on the current corpus was 979 ms without ZIP and 986 ms with ZIP. Paired input-only comparisons also found no repeatable slowdown. These controls do not attribute the full shift from the older 0.515/0.516 calibration to ZIP execution. Preserve RAM measurements, the 20 percent time tolerance, and every other benchmark.
